description: Key facts a correct lesson on each Engineering Chemistry topic must state. Every fact was taken from the fetched text of the source page named with it (the quote is checked by `npm run golden:check`). Patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions matched against the lesson text after LaTeX backslashes and braces are removed.
subject: engg-chemistry

facts.claim: Absorbance is proportional to concentration

source.quote: the amount of light that a solution absorbs is directly proportional to the solution's concentration

facts.claim: ...and to the path length

source.quote: to the optical path length through the sample and absorptivity of the species

facts.claim: E is related to the standard potential E°

source.quote: is the standard half-cell reduction potential

facts.claim: Uses the Faraday constant F (charge per mole of electrons)

source.quote: the magnitude of charge (in coulombs) per mole of electrons

facts.claim: Uses the reaction quotient Q

source.quote: The reaction quotient (Qr), also often called the ion activity product (IAP)

facts.claim: A negative ΔG is needed for a spontaneous reaction

source.quote: is necessary for a reaction to be spontaneous under these conditions

facts.claim: G = H − TS (enthalpy and entropy)

source.quote: is the enthalpy of the system

facts.claim: F = C − P + 2

source.quote: it relates the number of freely varying intensive properties (F) to the number of components (C), the number of phases (P)

facts.claim: Degrees of freedom = intensive variables that can be varied independently

source.quote: The number of degrees of freedom (F) in this context is the number of intensive variables which are independent of each other

facts.claim: Phases are e.g. solid, liquid and gas

source.quote: Typical phases are solid, liquid and gas

facts.claim: A eutectic mixture melts lower than its constituents

source.quote: has a melting point lower than those of the constituents

facts.claim: The lowest melting temperature is the eutectic point/temperature

source.quote: The lowest possible melting point over all of the mixing ratios of the constituents is called the eutectic temperature

facts.claim: Ligands split the d-orbitals in energy

source.quote: which results in the d-orbitals splitting in energy

facts.claim: The five d-orbitals lose their degeneracy

source.quote: considering energy changes of the five degenerate d-orbitals

facts.claim: MOs are linear combinations of atomic orbitals

source.quote: as linear combinations of atomic orbitals (LCAO)

facts.claim: Bonding and antibonding orbitals

source.quote: These are often divided into three types, bonding, antibonding, and non-bonding

facts.claim: Bond order = (bonding − antibonding electrons)/2

source.quote: subtracting the number of electrons in anti-bonding orbitals from the number of bonding orbitals, and the resulting number is then divided by two

facts.claim: Hückel's rule: 4n + 2 π electrons

source.quote: 4n + 2 for some integer n

facts.claim: Aromatic rings are planar

source.quote: Coplanar structure, with all the contributing atoms in the same plane

facts.claim: Benzene is more stable than expected (delocalisation)

source.quote: Benzene is a more stable molecule than would be expected without accounting for charge delocalization

facts.claim: Corrosion turns a refined metal into a more stable oxide

source.quote: Corrosion is a natural process that converts a refined metal into a more chemically stable oxide

facts.claim: It is an electrochemical process (rusting of iron is the familiar example)

source.quote: Rusting, the formation of red-orange iron oxides, is perhaps the most familiar example of electrochemical corrosion

facts.claim: A more easily corroded sacrificial metal acts as the anode

source.quote: connects the metal to be protected to a more easily corroded "sacrificial metal" to act as the anode

facts.claim: Sacrificial anodes are zinc, magnesium or aluminium

source.quote: Galvanic or sacrificial anodes are made in various shapes and sizes using alloys of zinc, magnesium, and aluminium

facts.claim: Galvanised steel: a zinc coating protects steel

source.quote: in galvanized steel, in which a sacrificial coating of zinc on steel parts protects them from rust

facts.claim: Octane number measures resistance to knocking

source.quote: a standard measure of a fuel's ability to withstand compression in an internal combustion engine without causing engine knocking

facts.claim: Defined against iso-octane (100) and n-heptane (0) blends

source.quote: The term refers to the equivalent ratio of a blend of iso-octane and heptane that produces the same knocking characteristics

facts.claim: Gross (higher) calorific value includes condensing the water vapour

source.quote: The HHV is determined by bringing all the products of combustion back to the original pre-combustion temperature, including condensing any vapor produced

facts.claim: Net (lower) calorific value excludes the heat used to vaporise water

source.quote: the LHV considers energy losses such as the energy used to vaporize water

facts.claim: Hardness comes from calcium and magnesium salts

source.quote: which are largely made up of calcium and magnesium carbonates, bicarbonates and sulfates

facts.claim: Permanent hardness is not removed by boiling

source.quote: Permanent hardness (mineral content) is generally difficult to remove by boiling

facts.claim: A chiral molecule cannot be superposed on its mirror image

source.quote: if it cannot be superposed on its mirror image

facts.claim: Its two mirror-image forms are enantiomers

source.quote: A chiral molecule or ion exists in two stereoisomers that are mirror images of each other, called enantiomers

facts.claim: A 50:50 mixture is racemic

source.quote: A homogeneous mixture of the two enantiomers in equal parts, a racemic mixture

facts.claim: Nanomaterials are 1–100 nm in at least one dimension

source.quote: sized (in at least one dimension) between 1 and 100 nm

facts.claim: Nanoscale structure gives unusual optical, electronic or mechanical properties

source.quote: Materials with structure at the nanoscale often have unique optical, electronic, thermo-physical or mechanical properties
